title: This is a show that’s going to be fully appreciated in 15 years a la ...
transcript: real women have curves is closing on June 29th and I am devastated this this is so sad to me I was really hoping that with the positive word of mouth that real women have curves would turn around in the same way that maybe happy ending did and really find their audience I'm I'm so sad that it was never able to do that this is such a gem of a show I I truly believe that in a any other season this would have been the best musical nominee it is just that good and that sweet and while I'm so devastated that this is no longer going to be on Broadway I truly believe that this is going to be in so many regional theaters and community theaters across the nation because it's a it's a story that feels so vital and yet it's a musical that feels so joyous at the same time I cannot wait to see local productions of Real Women Have Curves but if you have a chance before June 29th to see this on Broadway please take it it's just a great show that really deserves so much more and if you are unable to get to Broadway before June 29th do yourself a favor carve out an hour and some change and listen to this cast recording because even just the score is so good and I'm so glad we at least have that preserved
classificationReason: Creator shares clear first-hand opinion ('such a gem', 'in any other season this would have been the best musical nominee') and recommends seeing it before closing. Closure context does not override the personal review content.
